title: Hearty Juicy Mexican Datterini Tomato Flan
description: A comforting and flavorful Mexican dish featuring braised datterini tomatoes in a rich flan, perfect for a sick day. This jammy and juicy flan is a twist on traditional Mexican cuisine.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the datterini tomatoes, cumin, and paprika to the skillet and simmer for 10 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, heavy cream, and a pinch of salt.
Stir in the shredded cheese and crushed tortilla chips.
Pour the egg mixture over the tomato mixture in the skillet.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 35 minutes.
Remove the flan from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the flan warm, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
